title: The back of the Pullman house steps out
items: The rear wall of the Pullman house is no longer one flat face: its north half now stands forward under its own mansard roof, with the raised terrace in the corner, as J. W. Taylor's photograph from 18th Street shows it.
That forward half has two windows on each floor and a dormer over each pair. The south half keeps one window and one dormer, matching the photograph.
